hero.title: How fiber-powered Gig WiFi reaches every room
hero.subtitle: From the fiber-backed network to the xFi Gateway in your living room, here is the simple path your connection takes to power dozens of devices at once.
steps.title: Four steps from our network to your screens
steps.intro: No technician, no guesswork. Here is exactly how your WiFi gets from the Xfinity network to every device in your home.
item-1.title: Fiber-backed speed reaches your home
item-1.body: Gig-speed data travels over our fiber-powered network right up to your address, delivering up to 1 gigabit per second with the headroom for 4K streaming, gaming, and video calls at the same time.
item-2.title: The xFi Gateway turns it into WiFi
item-2.body: Your included xFi Gateway is a modem and router in one. It takes that incoming signal and broadcasts secure, whole-home WiFi, so coverage reaches the back bedroom just as strongly as the living room.
item-3.title: You self-install in minutes
item-3.body: The Xfinity app walks you through plugging in the Gateway and activating service. Most people are online in about 15 minutes on move-in day, with no technician visit to schedule.
item-4.title: You manage it all from the app
item-4.body: Turn on Advanced Security, set parental controls, pause WiFi at dinner, and check your speeds anytime. Your whole network lives in your pocket.
benefits.title: What that setup means for your home
benefits.body: Because the speed is fiber-backed and the Gateway is built for whole-home coverage, you get consistent performance even at peak hours across every connected device.

cta.title: Now that you know how it works, get connected
cta.body: Pick the speed that fits your home, self-install on your schedule, and lock your rate for five years.
